method.iteration_semantics: iterations_by_prime[p] is the number of modular doublings performed to the first return, equal to the independently generated minimal order.
method.law_checks: For listed small and composite odd q, repeat modular doubling q times for every admitted p and compare return-to-1 with ord_p(2)|q.
method.minimal_order: For each prime p, start residue=1 and repeatedly set residue=(2*residue)%p; count steps until the first return to 1. This first positive return is ord_p(2).
method.prime_generation: Sieve of Eratosthenes over integers 2..65535; emit odd primes.

provenance.hash_scope: UTF-8 canonical compact JSON with sorted keys over scope, prime_limit, primes, orders_by_prime, iterations_by_prime.
